model_annotation: The figure displays two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—across different training sets. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis (ranging from 0.0 to 0.4) as a function of steps on the x-axis (ranging from 0 to 500). The Llama-On-Policy-Easy model (blue line) starts at a reward of approximately 0.0 and steadily increases to around 0.4, showing a smooth upward trend. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy model (red line) also begins near 0.0, rises quickly, and stabilizes at a reward of about 0.4, with a slightly more volatile trajectory. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," uses the same x-axis scale but a y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.2. The Llama-On-Policy-Hard model (blue line) starts at 0.0 and increases slowly, reaching a reward of about 0.05 before plateauing. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model (red line) begins at 0.0, rises sharply to about 0.15, and then fluctuates around that level, showing more variability than the blue line.
